title: Distinct Subsequences
goal: Solve Distinct Subsequences: 2D DP: dp[i][j] counts ways to form t[0..j-1] from s[0..i-1] using or skipping matched characters.
strategy: 2D DP: dp[i][j] counts ways to form t[0..j-1] from s[0..i-1] using or skipping matched characters.
edgeCases: An empty target has one matching subsequence. Repeated source characters create different index choices even when their text is identical.
inputRules: Use at most 64 characters per string for the visual trace.
